title: CodeHelp-supported programming coursework
summary: Students use the guarded CodeHelp assistant while debugging and writing programs in introductory courses. The assistant provides high-level guidance rather than full code, and students apply that support to their existing laboratory and take-home programming tasks.

sources.title: From Automation to Cognition: Redefining the Roles of Educators and Generative AI in Computing Education
